a: Yes, it can be activated. As long as you can trash 7 or more digivolution cards from the bottom other than cards that can't be trashed, the play cost will be 0.
q: There are 8 digivolution cards under my EX2-007 [Mother D-Reaper], including 1 BT9-109 [X Antibody].
Can this card's 1st effect activate when this card would be played?

Effect: When you would play this Digimon, you may trash 7 or more digivolution cards from the bottom of 1 of your [Mother D-Reaper]s to set this Digimon's play cost to 0.
＜Rush＞ (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.)
[When Attacking] You may place 2 [ADR-02 Searcher]s from your trash under this Digimon in any order as its bottom digivolution cards to unsuspend this Digimon.
